<!-- pr-reviewer: cb03deb6a07b32718aeb9f9db344a96e11ad0e00 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

- The tool uses the existing `DeleteEntity` command as one undo step.
- The tool refuses fixtures and models used by operation sources, feature selections, area picks or stock.
- The refusal names the dependency and does not change the document or history.
- The skill row, decision record, process line and changelog line are present.

I reviewed this as a safety change because deletion removes model geometry from the document.
The trial merge with upstream main `c0c92ee865ae3c19a5bd4e8d7904c8ad2b5b29c7` was clean.
All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2455`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 4 of 4 steps, including the no-run build |
| App library | 363 passed; 1 ignored |
| `mcp_model` | 5 passed |
| `mcp_model_delete` | 6 passed |
| `commands_undo` | 30 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

I ran two mutations separately:

1. I bypassed the operation-source check. `delete_model_refuses_an_operation_source_without_history` failed because deletion succeeded.
2. I bypassed the from-model stock check. `delete_model_refuses_a_setups_model_stock_without_history` failed because deletion succeeded.

Each mutation built successfully and failed its test with exit code 101.
I restored the source after each mutation. All six deletion tests then passed again.
The working tree is clean. I made no commit and no push.

Requested before merge: none.

No goldens moved. The diff contains no `.nc` or `.cl` change.
The PR changes no UI file, dependency, build script or workflow.
I did not run the GUI, a physical machine, the batch gate or the release gate.
The new fixture uses OBJ. STEP metadata restoration uses the unchanged `DeleteEntity` command.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
